name: Painted Churches in the Troodos Region
description: Tucked into the pine-covered Troodos Mountains of central Cyprus, ten small churches and monasteries hold some of the finest Byzantine and post-Byzantine wall paintings anywhere. Dating from the 11th to the 16th century, many have plain rural exteriors and steep timber roofs, yet their interiors glow with saints and biblical scenes. Highlights include St Nicholas tis Stegis and St John Lampadistis.
